method: Inspected changed identities, semantic impact, check inventory, task prerequisites and phase targets. Each application used a fresh reviewed preview fingerprint. The prior preview was rejected after watched documentation and runtime files changed.
task_review: The release-gate section adds distribution, exact-tree first-use and promotion criteria under explicit owner instructions. It preserves the eight existing tasks, dependency graph, requirement mappings, verification matrix and frozen native observation. The new release checks remain pending.

instructions: Read changed inputs and actual decisions; preserve unrelated user edits and accepted architecture. Resolve semantic impact before regenerating dependent prose.
Update requirements then design for requirements-first, design then derived requirements for design-first, or the connected set for quick work. Preserve stable IDs and required behavior.
Regenerate only affected task/check definitions and verification plans. Existing code is not proof that the changed contract is satisfied. Historical reviews/results remain historical.

Applying this preview only reopens listed completion and rewinds the phase; it does not rewrite a contract, approve changes, run a test or grant authority. Review and reverify affected outcomes afterward.

applied.reason: Final distribution packaging changed shared runtime, consultation guidance and readiness checks. Reverify affected contracts on the exact source; retain the pinned native observation and earlier receipts.
